Important Information Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. Steps for Patch testing : 1. Prepare a small area of skin on the upper forearm by cleaning it thoroughly. Apply a small amount of the product to this patch of skin. 2. Let it sit for 15-20 minutes, but no longer than 30 minutes. 3. If you notice any itching, redness, burning, blistering, or irritation during this time, wash the area immediately and refrain from using the product. It's important to note that a patch test is only intended to detect early signs of irritation in response to the product and does not ensure similar reactions elsewhere on the body, such as the face, or with regular use. Furthermore, it doesn't account for any underlying skin conditions and should not be used to diagnose hypersensitivity or allergic contact dermatitis.
